change.before: "null object in values.yaml warned 'cannot overwrite table with non table' and the K8s object was not overridden"
change.after: "warning still emitted but the K8s object is overridden with the invalid null value"

consequence.statement: Rendered K8s objects are overridden with the invalid null value from values.yaml null objects, which may require editing values.yaml files for subcharts.
consequence.remediation: Identify values.yaml files with null object values and remove those null values.

assertion.statement: Helm was upgraded to 3.17.1, so a null object in subchart values.yaml now overrides the rendered K8s object with the invalid null value instead of being ignored with a warning.
